definitions.explanation: Products purchased and used directly by individuals to satisfy personal needs, as opposed to capital goods used in production.

examples.japanese: {消費財|しょうひざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}している→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
⟦{食料品|しょくりょうひん}→食料品：01439_shokuryouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{消費財|しょうひざい}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Food products are a typical example of consumer goods.

examples.japanese: {消費財|しょうひざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}される→左右される：26073_sayuusareru⟧。
examples.english: Demand for consumer goods is greatly influenced by economic trends.

notes:
An economics term composed of ⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧ (consumption) and {財|ざい} (goods; assets). Refers to goods purchased by end consumers for personal use. Contrasted with {生産財|せいさんざい} (capital goods/producer goods) used in manufacturing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{耐久|たいきゅう}→耐久：18768_taikyuu⟧{消費財|しょうひざい}: durable consumer goods (appliances, cars)
- {非耐久|ひたいきゅう}{消費財|しょうひざい}: non-durable consumer goods (food, toiletries)
- {消費財|しょうひざい}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: consumer goods market
- {消費財|しょうひざい}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: consumer goods manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生産財|せいさんざい}: capital goods; producer goods — goods used to produce other goods
- ⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧: daily necessities — overlaps with non-durable consumer goods but focuses on everyday household items
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: goods; merchandise — a broader term for any product for sale
